The front-right man touches his head and face, handles a blue-and-white item and a clear bottle, then taps a green-cased phone, holds it to his ear, lowers it and lifts a blue plush toy. A rear passenger handles a phone and white fabric. 30–60 seconds: The front-right man raises a phone to his ear, places the blue character-shaped toy on the console and briefly handles a small black device. Both front men turn toward the rear before facing forward again. The front-right man lowers the phone, leans toward the right window and fastens his seat belt, then holds a smartphone near the console. 60–90 seconds: He reaches toward the steering wheel area, handles the plush toy and a black case-like object, returns the toy to the console, adjusts his belt and puts on dark sunglasses. The front-left man keeps the laptop on his lap, while the rear passenger in blue looks down at a phone.
parent_context.visual_summary: A wide interior view shows a brown-seated vehicle, initially with four men visible, a steering wheel at lower right, and cables, small electronics and a blue plush toy around the center console. The front-left man in a light gray graphic T-shirt keeps an open laptop on his lap. During the first 30 seconds, the front-right man in a black polo handles a bottle, a green-cased phone and the plush toy; a rear man in a dark T-shirt holds a phone and white fabric, while another man in a blue track jacket sits farther back. During 30–60 seconds, the front-right man handles the blue large-eared character object and small devices, holds a phone to his ear and turns toward the rear alongside the front-left man. He later faces forward with a seat belt across his chest, a smartphone near the console and his other hand on the steering wheel. During 60–90 seconds, he reaches forward, handles the plush toy and a black zippered case, then puts on dark sunglasses. The rear man in a blue striped top looks down at a phone and later lifts a large gray bag upright.
